verdict_reason: Every linked test exists in trade-imports-ins-frontend @97c72f1, but two scenarios (003-C claim values, 003-D service session) are claimed full by tests that do not fully witness their Then/Given.

todos.issue: SCN-INS-AUTH-003-D is marked full, but the linked test 'Should leave an existing service session in the cache and set or clear no service session cookie' (trade-imports-ins-frontend src/server/auth/idm-sign-in.test.js @97c72f1) seeds the session in the cache and never sends the service session cookie with the callback request. The GIVEN (user signed in through the service's own sign-in) is therefore not set up: a callback that read the incoming service cookie and dropped that session from the cache would still pass. Only the set-cookie half is proven.
todos.fix: Must: the test linked as full for SCN-INS-AUTH-003-D sends the callback request with a real service session cookie for the cached session, so dropping or clearing that session turns it red; otherwise the link is marked partial. One way: build the cookie header with the existing address-book-requests helpers (cookieHeaderOf / a stub sign-in) and pass it in completeSignIn's headers.

todos.issue: SCN-INS-AUTH-003-C says the page 'lists every ID token claim with its value' and 'every access token claim', but the links marked full/partial assert only claim names: the ID-token test uses arrayContaining(['aud','iss','sub','contactId']) on dt text (a subset, no dd values) and the access-token test checks only that 'scp' appears. A claimRows that rendered wrong or empty values, or dropped sessionId/correlationId, would pass while the coverage claims full.
todos.fix: Must: the test linked as full for SCN-INS-AUTH-003-C asserts every ID token claim name paired with its rendered value (and likewise for access token claims), or the link's strength is lowered to partial. One way: compare the dt/dd pairs in [data-testid="id-token-claims"] to the signed token's payload with toEqual, and do the same for access-token-claims.

todos.issue: SCN-INS-AUTH-003-B's first THEN ('it shows a button to sign in with Defra ID') is linked full to 'Should show a start page whose button links to the route that goes to IDM', which asserts only the button's href, never its text; the page could label the button anything and still pass.
todos.fix: Must: the linked test asserts the start page's button text names signing in with Defra ID, or the link is marked partial. One way: add expect(textOf($, 'main a.govuk-button')).toBe(<the copy>) to that test.
